metadata.case_name: LO WAI YIN v. LI CHUN KOU

plaintiff.occupation_after: day supervisor (private club) and office assistant (trading firm) (two part-time jobs)
plaintiff.education_level: undergraduate degree in business (accounting) from the University of Central Queensland, Australia

injuries.description: Miss Lo suffered a fracture right ilium (the upper pelvic bone). Operation by open reduction and internal fixation by screws was performed 6 days after the operation on 17 January 2003.
source: Miss Lo suffered a fracture right ilium (the upper pelvic bone). Operation by open reduction and internal fixation by screws was performed 6 days after the operation on 17 January 2003.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of ilium without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: Post-traumatic stress and adjustment disorder with depressed symptoms as the result of the accident (psychiatric conditions)
source: In his report, Dr. Lai found that Miss Lo suffered from two psychiatric conditions 	6 post-traumatic stress and adjustment disorder with depressed symptoms as the result of the accident.

injuries.description: The two operations have left Miss Lo with a C-shaped, 15-cm long scare on her right buttock.
source: The two operations have left Miss Lo with a C-shaped, 15-cm long scare on her right buttock.

According to Dr. Lams letter dated 23 December 2008 (which documents the findings of the examination in 2006), Miss Lo was found to have " a buttock scar of 14.5 cm, which showed signs of widening, thickening and obvious stitch marks. There was presence of soft tissue depression in the scar region as well."
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: soreness over the right side of her buttock
limitation of movement on the right hip
mild tenderness at the scar over the right posterior ilium
avoidance of sex due to pain during sex
visible surgical scar at the posterior pelvis area

treatments_received: admitted to Accident and Emergency Department of Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital
open reduction and internal fixation by screws (surgical fixation)
one week of physiotherapy at the Hospital
three follow-up sessions at the Hospital after discharge
private orthopaedic consultations with Dr. Fang (11 June 2003, 20 October 2003, 16 February 2005 and further consultations up to January 2008)
physiotherapist treatments (total about 5 times between June 2003 and second operation)
osteopathic, chiropractic and acupuncture treatments in Australia (about 8 times between January 2004 to October 2005)
second operation to remove the metal screws on 21 June 2006 by Dr. Fang
another 4 consultations with Dr. Fang up to January 2008 and 20 private physiotherapy sessions up to August 2008
consultation with government clinical psychologist (Miss Liu) on 26 May 2003
27 sessions of psychiatric treatment with Dr. Lai from 25 September 2006 up till August 2008
one 3-hour counseling session with the Mental Health Association of Hong Kong in December 2006
consultation with plastic surgeon Dr. Lam Lai Kan on 14 September 2006

losses.description: Residual pain, limitation of movement and weakness following fracture of right ilium
C-shaped, 15-cm long scar on right buttock which had become thicker and wider with soft tissue depression

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Avoidance of sex and decreased sex drive resulting from pain during sex after the accident
Breakdown of marriage which the judge found the accident contributed to and which was to be taken into account in assessing PSLA
